b2-34-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Greeting an Older Woman
b2-34-01.scenario: You are Meg. You meet an older woman you do not know, and you want to greet her politely.
b2-34-01.prompt: Greet the woman politely and ask how she is.
cues: Greet her with the right title
Ask how she is, using the formal form
b2-34-01.english: Good afternoon, madam. How are you?
b2-34-01.canDo: I can choose between *tú* and *usted* for the person I am talking to.

b2-34-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Word for Mobile Phone
b2-34-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks which word she should use for a mobile phone in Latin America.
b2-34-02.prompt: Tell Meg which word is used.
b2-34-02.target: En casi toda América Latina se dice celular.
b2-34-02.english: In almost all of Latin America people say celular.
b2-34-02.canDo: I can recognise common regional words, such as *carro* and *auto* or *departamento* and *apartamento*.

b2-34-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Closing the Window
b2-34-03.scenario: You are Carlos. In the office you want to ask a colleague, politely, to close the window.
b2-34-03.prompt: Ask your colleague politely to close the window.
cues: Ask if the person would mind closing it
b2-34-03.english: Sorry, would you mind closing the window?
b2-34-03.canDo: I can make a request gentle with *quería*, *¿podría…?* and *¿le importaría…?*.

b2-34-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Please Sign Here
b2-34-04.scenario: You are Carlos. In the office a visitor needs to sign a form, and you ask him formally.
b2-34-04.prompt: Ask the visitor formally to sign the form here.
b2-34-04.target: Le ruego que firme aquí, por favor.
b2-34-04.english: I ask you to sign here, please.
b2-34-04.canDo: I can ask for something formally with *le ruego que* and *le agradecería que*.

b2-34-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Ways to Say Hello
b2-34-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks how you say hello to a friend and how you say it to a stranger.
cues: Give the greeting for a friend
Give the greeting for a stranger
b2-34-05.target: A un amigo le digo «Hola, ¿qué tal?»; a un desconocido, «Buenos días, ¿cómo está usted?».
b2-34-05.english: To a friend I say "Hello, how are you?"; to a stranger, "Good morning, how are you?" in the formal form.
b2-34-05.canDo: I can say the same message in a formal and an informal register.

b2-34-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Was Scorza?
b2-34-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks who Manuel Scorza was, after you both read a short text about him.
b2-34-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg who Scorza was and when he died.
cues: Say what he was and where he was from
b2-34-consolidation.target: Manuel Scorza fue un escritor peruano; murió en 1983.
b2-34-consolidation.english: Manuel Scorza was a Peruvian writer; he died in 1983.
b2-34-consolidation.canDo: I can read a short text about Manuel Scorza and his novel Redoble por Rancas.
